decisions.reason: Uses ls-remote gap v0.9.2-v0.9.6 and the HEAD:main-only sync script to explain attempt-1 ref non-resolution; explicitly rules out network/typo.
Explains v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1 useConversation absent on frozen 0.1.1-rc.2; install success/restart cannot fix a deterministic API mismatch.

Selects v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification + additive rc.2 note, notes v0.9.3 also absent from mirror, gives #v0.9.3 install gated on maintainer tag push with conditional origin-repo fallback; no invented SHA, no runtime upgrade.
Proposes per-mirror git push refs/tags/<tag> grounded in the branch-only loop, plus ls-remote verification per mirror.
Runtime-routed install table (rc.x -> v0.9.3, alpha.1 -> v0.9.7) with dsh --version step and compat matrix as release gate; no blanket future-alpha claim.
